rows.question: 各型号售出30天激活率

assessment.reason: 分组和数值与独立Python计算一致

rows.sql: WITH "cohort" AS (SELECT "b"."device_id" AS "device_id", "d"."product_id" AS "product_id", "o"."paid_date" AS "paid_date" FROM "bridge_order_device" AS "b" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "i" ON "b"."item_id" = "i"."item_id" JOIN "fact_order" AS "o" ON "i"."order_id" = "o"."order_id" JOIN "dim_device" AS "d" ON "b"."device_id" = "d"."device_id" WHERE "o"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-10-16' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '30' DAYS), "outcomes" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c"."device_id" AS "device_id" FROM "cohort" AS "c" JOIN "fact_device_activation" AS "e" ON "c"."device_id" = "e"."device_id" WHERE "e"."activation_date" BETWEEN "c"."paid_date" AND "c"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAYS) SELECT "p"."product_name" AS "product_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "c"."device_id") AS "devices", COUNT(DISTINCT "e"."device_id") AS "matched_devices", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "e"."device_id") / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "c"."device_id"), 0), 2) AS "rate_percent" FROM "cohort" AS "c" JOIN "dim_product" AS "p" ON "c"."product_id" = "p"."product_id" LEFT JOIN "outcomes" AS "e" ON "c"."device_id" = "e"."device_id" GROUP BY "p"."product_name" ORDER BY "rate_percent" DESC LIMIT 1001

rows.sql: WITH "cohort" AS (SELECT "b"."device_id" AS "device_id", "d"."product_id" AS "product_id", "o"."paid_date" AS "paid_date" FROM "bridge_order_device" AS "b" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "i" ON "b"."item_id" = "i"."item_id" JOIN "fact_order" AS "o" ON "i"."order_id" = "o"."order_id" JOIN "dim_device" AS "d" ON "b"."device_id" = "d"."device_id" WHERE "o"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-10-16' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '30' DAYS AND STRFTIME("o"."paid_date", '%Y-%m') = '2026-03'), "outcomes" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c"."device_id" AS "device_id" FROM "cohort" AS "c" JOIN "fact_service_ticket" AS "e" ON "c"."device_id" = "e"."device_id" WHERE "e"."created_date" BETWEEN "c"."paid_date" AND "c"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAYS) SELECT "p"."product_name" AS "product_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "c"."device_id") AS "devices", COUNT(DISTINCT "e"."device_id") AS "matched_devices", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "e"."device_id") / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "c"."device_id"), 0), 2) AS "rate_percent" FROM "cohort" AS "c" JOIN "dim_product" AS "p" ON "c"."product_id" = "p"."product_id" LEFT JOIN "outcomes" AS "e" ON "c"."device_id" = "e"."device_id" GROUP BY "p"."product_name" ORDER BY "rate_percent" DESC LIMIT 1001
